saṃkalpavikalpātmakasya manasaḥ saṃkalpo mūlaṃ tannirodhe
mūlocchedādvikalpānutthāne nirvikalpapadapratiṣṭhāsiddhiriti sūcanāya
prāgavatāritāṃ bālakākhyāyikāṃ śrotukāmo rāmaḥ pṛcchati - kimucyata
iti

bālakākhyāyikālakṣaṇaḥ kramo dṛṣṭāntaḥ kiṃprakāro loke ucyate etatkrameṇa
kathayetyarthaḥ

te kadācidvibandhavo daivānmṛtabāndhavā durbhikṣādinā khinnamukhāśca
santaḥ samavāyataḥ svanāgarasamājāt parasparaikamatyato vā uttamasya
nagarāntarasya lābhārthaṃ nirjagmuriti śeṣaḥ

karaṇatāśaktereva
saṃbandhasāmānyātmanā vivakṣaṇātṣaṣṭhī andhasya
locanayorgolakayordṛṣṭirindriyamiva saritorambu na vidyata iti vā

nīlākāśā iva sundarāḥ
śūnyā vā jalāśayā yatra
tatra teṣu triṣu madhye abhittimandiraṃ te praviṣṭāḥ

andhasaḥ odanaprakṛtestaṇḍulasya navanavatyā
droṇairekena ca droṇena hīnaṃ nyūnaṃ droṇaśataṃ randhitaṃ pakvam

cittākhyānānantaraṃ pravṛttā yā jagatpratyayasya vikalpamātratvakathā tāṃ
prati tadudāharaṇatvenetyarthaḥ

vikalpā eva jālakāni yasyāmiti vigrahe
samāsādutpannasya ṭāpaḥ supaḥ paratvāt pratyayasthātkātpūrvasya
ityasyāpravṛttiḥ

yato yatkiṃcidvikalparūpaṃ bhāti tatsarvaṃ saṃkalpavaśato
bhāti

śabdajñānānupātī
vastuśūnyo vikalpaḥ iti patañjalinā tathā tallakṣaṇokteriti bhāvaḥ
saṃkalpatyāge ca nirvikalpātmaniścaya eva heturityāha - āśrityeti
